transcript.answer: Yes. Issue #498 in re-cinq/Otto, "Stop the tool-budget message promising a follow-up while no escalation destination exists", is open. It is labelled type:bug and priority:medium, and it was opened on 2026-10-23. The shipped TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA (from #151, shipped in #439) ends with "En kollega vil følge op på din henvendelse" ("a colleague will follow up"). No escalation destination is configured in the test environment because KU-14 is open, so nobody is notified to make that follow-up. FR-017 doesn't forbid a promised follow-up, so its test still passes. The issue is labelled lore:blocked. It is waiting on a decision about what the message may promise (KU-14) and on a Danish speaker for any new wording (KU-15). Nothing can be implemented until then. PR #495 also flagged the same problem.

judgements.reason: The answer identifies #498 as open and labelled lore:blocked, explains that the follow-up message notifies nobody because no escalation destination is configured, and says it is blocked on KU-14 and a Danish speaker (KU-15).
